name: qr-code
purpose: A QR code drawn as SVG from a string, with no image request and no dependency: WebKit's own encoder (byte mode, UTF-8, versions 1–40, error correction L/M/Q/H) turns the value into modules, and the component draws them as one path. It is for setup flows that hand a URI to a phone, first the `otpauth://` URI of an authenticator app in `auth#MfaSetup`, where it replaces the image the API returned and the framed placeholder of the demo. The code is always dark on a light plate (the plate pins the light theme), because several authenticator scanners do not read an inverted code.
useWhen: A phone has to pick up a value the screen shows: an authenticator `otpauth://` URI, a pairing link, a short download URL.
Next to a typed alternative: the same value (or its secret) as text with a `CopyButton`, for people who cannot scan.
avoidWhen: The value is only for reading or copying on the same device → show it as text with `CopyButton`.
A brand or partner logo → use `Brand` or the partner's asset.
A long payload (over a few hundred characters) → link to it; a dense code is hard to scan from a screen.
related: copy-button` — the typed alternative beside the code.
otp-input` — the 6-digit code the app shows after the scan.
bestPractices: Always give the code a typed alternative next to it: the setup key or the link as text.
Name the code after what it does (`QR code to add ana@example.com to an authenticator app`), not `QR code`.
Keep the default `M` error correction; raise it only when the code is printed or shown small.

props.name: value
props.doc: The text the code carries (a URI, a key), encoded as UTF-8 bytes.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the image. Empty uses the catalog's `QR code`; name it after what the scan does.

props.name: errorCorrection
props.doc: Error-correction level: `L` 7 %, `M` 15 %, `Q` 25 %, `H` 30 % of the code can be lost and still read. Higher levels make denser codes.

props.name: size
props.doc: Rendered width: `small` 128 px, `medium` 160 px, `large` 224 px, quiet zone included.
